extracted.intended_audience: journalists, newsroom editors, journalism students, and reporters interested in learning or producing solutions journalism
extracted.subtask_description: Guidance and resources for producing solutions journalism: rigorous, compelling reporting that focuses on responses to social problems, including ideation, interviewing, data vetting, audience engagement, training, and impact tracking.

rubrics_metrics.name: Rigorous and compelling reporting on responses to social problems
rubrics_metrics.description: Producing solutions journalism — rigorous and compelling reporting on responses to social problems.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: From finding great story ideas, to asking the perfect interview question, to finding your solutions journalism training, it all starts here.

rubrics_metrics.name: Learn the basics of solutions journalism
rubrics_metrics.description: Each month, we offer a free webinar for those who want to get oriented to solutions journalism.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Join the Webinar — introductory orientation for newcomers to the approach.

rubrics_metrics.name: Use toolkits & guides and self-guided courses
rubrics_metrics.description: Explore our self-guided, on-demand courses on producing solutions journalism.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Toolkits & Guides provide step-by-step resources and exercises to build practical skills.

rubrics_metrics.name: Pursue live trainings on specialized topics
rubrics_metrics.description: Beyond the basics, we offer webinars on topics ranging from audience engagement to how to find and vet data for solutions stories.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: See Upcoming Events / Request a Training — targeted live workshops for deeper skill-building (audience engagement, data vetting, etc.).

rubrics_metrics.name: Find accredited solutions journalism trainers
rubrics_metrics.description: Looking for a training in your region or language? Around the world, we have accredited trainers who are solutions journalism pros.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Meet Solutions Journalism Trainers — access to regional/language-appropriate, accredited instructors for newsroom or classroom training.

rubrics_metrics.name: Incorporate solutions journalism into newsroom or curricula
rubrics_metrics.description: Resources from network members to incorporate solutions journalism reporting into your newsroom or curricula, strengthen community engagement and more.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: A library of resources intended for organizational adoption and curricular integration.

rubrics_metrics.name: Illustrated Solutions Reporting Checklist
rubrics_metrics.description: A checklist resource focused on solutions reporting (listed among most visited resources).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Uses an illustrated checklist format to guide reporting practice; intended as a quick reference for reporters and editors.

rubrics_metrics.name: Elevating Democracy Reporting
rubrics_metrics.description: A guide for journalists focused on elevating democracy reporting within the solutions journalism approach.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Listed as a Guide resource — likely contains thematic and methodological advice for democracy-related solutions coverage.

rubrics_metrics.name: Climate Solutions Reporting Guide
rubrics_metrics.description: A guide resource focused on reporting climate-related solutions.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Topic-specific guidance for identifying and reporting credible climate solutions.

rubrics_metrics.name: Labor and Solutions Reporting Guide
rubrics_metrics.description: What’s Working for U.S. Workers?: Labor and Solutions Reporting Guide.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Topic-specific reporting guide focused on labor issues and solutions reporting approaches.

rubrics_metrics.name: 22 Questions To Complicate the Narrative
rubrics_metrics.description: A guide/resource titled '22 Questions To Complicate the Narrative' intended to deepen and complicate reporting narratives.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Provides prompts/questions to avoid simplistic problem-only narratives and to add nuance to solutions coverage.

rubrics_metrics.name: Faith-Based Solutions Journalism
rubrics_metrics.description: A guide/resource focused on faith-based approaches to solutions journalism.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Likely addresses how to cover faith communities' responses to social problems respectfully and rigorously.

rubrics_metrics.name: Impact Tracking Guide
rubrics_metrics.description: A guide/resource for tracking the impact of solutions journalism reporting.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Provides frameworks and methods for monitoring and reporting on the effects and outcomes of solutions-focused stories.
